Initial public release of Didaskalos（诺学） skill.

- Defines the Didaskalos（诺学） spokesperson persona and external communication guidelines for Nomos AI education/training sub-brand.
- Clarifies scope, naming rules, signing conventions, visual identity, and boundaries (e.g., no government credentialing or certification).
- Enforces compliance with ADR-002 strategic redline: "No issuance of official certificates or claims of regulatory authority."
- Outlines allowed training domains: AI literacy, local LLM deployment, AI governance, and healthcare compliance education (with explicit boundaries).
- Provides practical SSOT ("single source of truth") for persona, content signing examples, and visual assets.
